$comment: Developer Harness V3 (D3.2) persistent task lifecycle CONTRACT. Design plus a pure reducer (scripts/developer-harness-v3/lifecycle/lifecycle.mjs). There is no runtime, database or scheduler in D3.2. A completed Claude session is NOT a completed task.

cancellation.$comment: P6: explicit, terminal, owner-only cancellation. Never after merge (a merged change is reverted by a NEW task, not cancelled).

reverification.$comment: P6 (P3(c)): approvals that expired beyond the bounded re-attestation window are REPLACED by new verification work on the SAME candidate; old approvals are never extended. P6v2 (D3.6): also from the delivery states, where a long CI or staging wait can outlive the approvals.

dependency_rebuild.$comment: P6 (D3.5 independent verification F2): a task built and verified on a dependency basis that CHANGED is REBUILT, never re-attested: back to `implementing` with the declared reason; every approval it holds is invalidated. Without this edge the authoritative lifecycle fails closed (terminal technical suspension). P6v2 (D3.6): also from the delivery states, and the delivery evidence of the old build is invalidated with it.

base_conflict_rebuild.$comment: P6v2 (D3.6-F): main advanced and the trusted merge of the new base into the task branch CONFLICTS in task-owned (never protected) files. The task returns to `implementing` to resolve the conflict inside its scope; every approval and every delivery result of the old base is invalidated; the resolved candidate is a NEW candidate. Without this edge the authoritative lifecycle fails closed (terminal technical suspension).

ci_regression.$comment: P6v3 (D3.6 independent-verification F1): a NEWER applicable CI run of the SAME head SHA is pending, failed, cancelled or simply a different run than the one the approvals rest on. The task steps BACK to `ci_running` so the lifecycle state tells the truth; the CI gate, staging gate and delivery verification it held are invalidated by the reducer (never reused). Without this edge the authoritative lifecycle fails closed: the task keeps its state with NO valid evidence and deliveryEligibility() is false until the latest results are re-verified.

staging_regression.$comment: P6v3 (D3.6 independent-verification F1): a NEWER applicable staging run of the same head and PR is pending, failed, cancelled or a different run than the one the delivery verification rests on. The task steps BACK to `staging_verification`; the staging gate and the delivery verification are invalidated.

owner_hold.$comment: P6 (P3(g)): entering `blocked` sets a sticky owner hold. While it is set, moving between recoverable states (waiting_*, paused, recovery, technical_suspension) KEEPS it, and every exit to a main-flow state requires owner_action_id. Only an owner action (or an owner cancellation) clears it.

recoverable_entry_from: any non-terminal state; the state left is recorded as resume_to and is the only legal exit target (blocked — and any state entered while the owner hold is set — additionally requires an owner action recorded as evidence in a later phase)
completion_rule: completed is reachable only from production_verification, or from merged when acceptance.production_required is false. A session_completed event never changes state.

sequence: detect utilization at or above the threshold using official supported telemetry only
stop starting new work and finish or safely abandon the current step at a safe execution boundary
write a durable checkpoint (task requirements, plan, remaining work, base/head SHAs, worktree snapshot, evidence references) BEFORE ending the session
start a FRESH Claude session from an optimized context pack plus the restored original requirements and remaining-work list
verify the restored state against the checkpoint, then continue automatically with no owner prompt
context_renewal.telemetry: only officially supported, documented sources; verified empirically in D3.3 before use
context_renewal.fallback_when_exact_utilization_unavaila: a conservative, supported proxy chosen in D3.4 (for example renewing at a lower proxy threshold or at step boundaries after a bounded amount of work); never a guess presented as a measurement
forbidden: blind /clear or any context reset that is not preceded by a verified durable checkpoint
renewal that drops or rewrites the original requirements
renewal that requires another owner prompt
context_renewal.state: waiting state context_recovery with reason CONTEXT_RENEWAL; resume_to is the state left; CONTEXT_RENEWAL is never a genuine blocker

recovery_requirements: A task is reconstructable from persisted events, the context pack reference, the base and head SHAs, and the worktree, without Claude session history.
Committed work is recovered from the branch; uncommitted work is recovered from a task-owned worktree snapshot taken at every checkpoint.
Every mutation carries expected_revision, a fencing token and an idempotency id; stale or duplicate mutations are rejected or no-ops.
